Mistress '''Shimel''' is a merchant in [[Far Madding]]. She is stout with a round face and black hair in a tight roll atop her head.
==Activities==
While in [[The Golden Wheel]] inn, she advises Master [[Posavina]] against traveling to [[Tear]] for the winter, because she heard the [[Stone of Tear]] is under siege.
